semiconductor_relevance: High — Daigo Electronic Industry specializes in manufacturing parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly focusing on airtight and watertight components essential for thin-film deposition and vacuum systems.
summary: Daigo Electronic Industry has over 40 years of experience in producing high-quality parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. They excel in in-house capabilities such as sheet metal processing, machining, and welding, offering a range of products including vacuum chambers and piping solutions.
capabilities: Airtight and watertight parts for thin-film deposition and cleaning equipment
In-house sheet metal processing and machining
Fiber laser welding for thin and thick materials
